input_guards.random_contract: Resident generator and retained Crystal tape generator both use Random.new(seed), rand.to_f32 and an 11-slot stride; chunk0 starts at draw0. Native uses 11 slots per non-EOS frame and main/retry only on EOS; MLX uses all 11 on EOS. Source/launch consistency, not execution attestation.

official_text_chunk_control.cross_chunk_alignment_limit: MLX decodes residual codebooks before checking terminal EOS and consumes all 11 draws; native breaks after main/retry on EOS. No native chunk2 arm or cross-chunk native tape-offset equivalence is claimed.
